chapter: Later views and life in Dallas
title: Working with George Lee in the Ozarks
summary: Smith spent a summer with George Lee, a hot-tempered baritone player and ballad singer.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah, it might have been. I went down there with George Lee and stayed one summer down in the Ozarks. It might have been. But that's the first of me hearing of that.
What was George Lee like to work with?
Well, George Lee was all right. He was fine. But he was kind of mean. He was kind of high-tempered.
Yeah, high-tempered. He wanted everything to be his way. In other words, he didn't want nobody to make no mistakes. And he was (?) way up all the time.
He played a little baritone -- mostly baritone. But he would sing like the devil. He was a good singer.
Did he sing like Jimmy Rushing?
No. He sang more something around like...
Playing sort of popular songs, ballads...?
Yeah, ballads. Yeah, he went for that.
